copy.curiosityHook: When the patriotic ideals he fought for collapse upon his return home, how does one veteran channel deep betrayal into national defiance?
copy.description: Paralyzed during the Vietnam War, Ron Kovic returns home to face profound physical trauma, rising disillusionment, and a nation that leaves him feeling betrayed by the cause he served.
copy.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful, and deliberately paced, offering an emotionally demanding drama best experienced with focused attention.
copy.whyWatch: Oliver Stone directs a weighty biographical drama that transforms personal sacrifice and wartime trauma into a passionate awakening for civil rights and peace.

allowedMaterial: Ron Kovic paralyzed in the Vietnam War
Feeling betrayed by the country he fought for
Becoming an anti-war and pro-human rights political activist
Oliver Stone's direction and biographical drama framework
excludedMaterial: Detailed resolution of his personal rehabilitation
